$comment: Act 4 health 0 (ADR-145, plan §3.5 and §8 Q4): you fail forward — no game over. The night has already passed (TimeManager.sleep: Act 4 day +1) and half of what you carried is gone before this plays. It lands at the base; S3 makes the base the one you last slept in (until then, the hill flat).

panels.text: You don't remember the way back.

panels.title: MORNING
panels.text: Your bag is lighter. Your hands won't stop shaking.
